data.title: bn-186: Raise RIBBIT RECOIL visuals to reference quality
data.description: Reference-driven cart visual overhaul; fresh visual judge PASS 7.8/10. Verify runtime safety, deterministic cart behavior, camera/pit logic preservation, and playtest evidence changes.

data.body: [high] Keep the frog on-screen when the boss camera is active. This weighted target does not actually frame both actors across the allowed arena: with the second checkpoint/player at x=650 and the boss alive, 60 updates converge camera_x to 678.37, putting the 14 px player at screen x=-28.37 (entirely invisible). The same state occurs after a boss-fight death because reset_player returns to checkpoint x=650 while camera tracking remains boss-locked. Clamp the camera target so player_x and the boss's visual bounds remain inside the viewport, or constrain the arena/player before enabling this composition.

[medium] Align Colonel Buzzkill's interactive bounds with the new silhouette. draw_buzzkill now renders from roughly e.x-33 through e.x+69 and e.y-13 through e.y+40 (wings/cannon/body/shield), but the boss is still w=24,h=24 and tongue/laser/contact checks use only that old box (lines 257-261, 527-529, 691-692, 968-970). As a result the tongue and beams visibly pass through most of the boss, and the frog can overlap the rendered body/wings without contact damage. Preserve a small vulnerable core if desired, but separate attack/core bounds from a collision/contact envelope that matches the readable body.

data.reason: Boss camera can place the player entirely offscreen after retreat/respawn, and the enlarged boss silhouette is materially misaligned with its 24x24 interaction/contact bounds. See th-7mh59n and th-db71vg.

data.body: Fixed: boss camera now clamps both the smoothed target and actual camera to a 16px player-safe frame on both axes. Added regression reproducing x=650 retreat for 60 updates.

Fixed: added explicit boss weapon bounds matching the full visible rig and a closed-pod contact envelope; decorative wings remain non-damaging. Tongue, laser, fire, explosion, and contact paths now use the appropriate envelope. Added a tongue regression against the previously non-interactive upper-left rig.

data.reason: Verified in f6c79a1: boss camera target and live camera are player-safe-clamped, weapon/contact envelopes are split and used by all interaction paths, and the new focused regression passes.
